data.name: Nakka
data.gender_notes: Nakka is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘nakha’, meaning ‘claw’ or ‘tooth’. In Hindu mythology, Nakka refers to the demon king Nalasena, who was vanquished by Lord Hanuman. This name symbolizes courage and victory. The name Nakka carries the meaning “Victorious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nakka usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace the inner warrior and conquer challenges with courage and determination.
data.etymology: Nakka belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nakka total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name “Nakka” is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘nakha’, which means ‘claw’ or ‘tooth’ in English. This name holds significant cultural importance in Hindu mythology. In one of the stories, Nakka refers to the demon king Nalasena, who was vanquished by Lord Hanuman. Though Nalasena was a powerful demon, he was defeated by Lord Hanuman’s courage and strength, making the name “Nakka” symbolic of courage and victory.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name “Nakka” holds deep significance. It symbolizes the victory of divine power and good over evil. The defeat of the demon king Nalasena by Lord Hanuman indicates the triumph of honesty, truth, and righteousness over deceit and wickedness. This name inspires the bearer to be courageous, steadfast, and victorious in their endeavors, relying on their inner strength and divine support. It serves as a reminder that no matter how formidable an opponent may seem, with faith and determination, one can overcome even the greatest obstacles.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Nakka in Hinduism symbolizes strength, resilience, and endurance. It is believed that those named Nakka possess the inner fortitude to overcome adversity and challenges in life. The name is derived from the Tamil word 'nakku', meaning 'strong' or 'powerful'.
